Release run [40667651819](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/actions/runs/40667651819) failed in Windows x64 delta preparation with its underlying error suppressed, and in Windows ARM64 archive signing with a Rekor `409 createLogEntryConflict`.

## Requirement and validation ownership

- Existing owners: `scripts/release/delta.mjs`, `scripts/release/updater.mjs` and `.github/workflows/release.yml`; authoritative policy: `docs/updates.md`.
- Acceptance: canonical binary/bundle bytes restore after both successful and rejected delta preparation across simulated volumes; underlying errors remain visible without signing secrets; Rekor conflicts and recognized temporary service failures retry at most three times; permanent failures stop immediately; exhausted/partial attempts leave no final bundle.
- Both desktop and post-office archives use the same signing owner. `scripts/validation/validation.json` registers the new regression suite, also discovered by existing CI diagnostics globs.
- Product versions, wire/storage formats, update installation behavior and publication authorization are unchanged. Signed full-version authentication, representation equivalence, exact-source checks and all final verification gates remain mandatory.

- `make verify-changed`: affected formatting/lint/types/builds, Clippy with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`, workflow/release/validation diagnostics, 77 Rust updater tests and 25 frontend tests.

Full workspace tests and comprehensive cross-platform/native/browser/security acceptance are delegated to the required current-head PR CI, not claimed from the focused local checks. This PR does not bypass any merge or release gate.

## Change alignment

- M04 aligned: the owning update guide documents same-filesystem restoration, secret-safe diagnostics and bounded signing behavior.
- M11/M12 aligned for source: workflow arguments, retry bounds, bundle lifecycle and existing verification/publication contracts agree. No product version bump or release dispatch is included.

## Risks and evidence gaps

The cross-volume regression injects the filesystem boundary and executes on macOS and Windows; it does not reproduce the original hosted x64 exception, which the old generic handler discarded. The fix removes a reproducible defect in that path and exposes any remaining native failure clearly.

content.text:

**Fixed, merged, and published:** [Nightly `0.4.5-nightly.41277904891.1`](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/releases/tag/v0.4.5-nightly.41277904891.1).

The failure came from Ubuntu’s **7-Zip 26.00 misreading valid NSIS installer metadata**. Earlier tests mocked that native-tool boundary, so they missed it.

[PR #320](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/pull/320) pins checksum-verified **26.05** across producers/verifiers and adds a real NSIS regression to required CI.

Verified:

- All **27 protected PR checks** and **22 required main checks** passed.
- All **six Nightly platforms** and both artifact-verification passes succeeded.
- **61 published assets** match the verified draft snapshot.
- Stable `v0.4.4` remains unchanged.

English note:  
Original: “why still fail?”  
Better: “Why is the release workflow still failing?”  
Why: Put “is” before the subject in this question.  
Useful pattern: “Please verify the published artifacts.”  
Collocations: toolchain mismatch, artifact verification, required checks.

明白，基准是 **v0.4.3 Lite**。实际下载、解包对比后确认：**你记得没错，之前约10MB；现在60多MB，主要是发布ZIP塞进了重复的更新载荷。**

当前单一发行版继承的仍是原Lite配置，没有切回以前的Full版。

以macOS ARM64为例，统一按十进制MB计算：

| 对比项 | v0.4.3 Lite | 最新Nightly |
|---|---:|---:|
| 用户下载的ZIP | 10.35MB | **61.58MB** |
| ZIP里的实际DMG安装包 | 10.39MB | **15.76MB** |
| App可执行文件，未压缩 | 25.42MB | 39.84MB |

数据来自实际发布文件：[v0.4.3](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/releases/tag/v0.4.3)、[最新Nightly](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/releases/tag/v0.4.5-nightly.41277904891.1)。

**61.58MB里面究竟装了什么？**

下面是各部分经过外层ZIP压缩后，实际占用的下载体积：

| 内容 | 占用 |
|---|---:|
| 真正用于安装的DMG | 15.67MB |
| 完整自动更新包，又一份App | 15.80MB |
| 增量更新重建目标，再一份App | 15.30MB |
| 两份历史版本增量补丁 | 14.80MB |
| 签名、校验及ZIP元数据 | 约0.01MB |

**约74.6%的下载体积来自安装时不需要的更新文件。** 而且这些文件已经作为独立Release资产发布，自动更新也直接下载那些独立资产。

原因就在[发布工作流](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/blob/6730516679bf91b8d4af2de5a3fea3e9bb9c34f6/.github/workflows/release.yml#L337)：它先打包安装程序，再把完整更新包、原始更新目标和增量补丁全部追加到同一个ZIP。

这分两次引入：[#283](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/pull/283)加入完整更新包，随后[#301](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/pull/301)加入原始目标和补丁。最近修复CI后成功发布，才把这些累积的体积变化完整暴露出来。

实际DMG增长约**51.7%**。检查确认：

- 没有模型包或额外大型资源；App里仍只有可执行文件、图标和配置。
- 没有合并两种CPU架构；比较的两个文件都是ARM64。
- 发布日志确认是优化后的release构建。
- 可执行文件增长主要来自机器码约**9.19MB**，以及链接、符号数据约**3.11MB**。期间新增的账户同步、图片解码、自动更新、增量更新等功能确实带来了代码增长，但不能仅凭依赖清单精确分摊每项成本。

另一个优化点是符号：配置虽然写了`strip="symbols"`，实际macOS成品仍保留大量本地符号。对副本进一步裁剪的实验，压缩后约省**0.97MB**；这需要完整打包及运行验证，也解释不了60MB的问题。

合理的修复顺序是：

2. 同步调整签名清单、校验器和发布契约，保留当前完整性验证；不能只删一行打包命令。
3. 分别为安装包、可执行文件和更新资产设置体积预算，随后用受控构建分析剩余代码增长。

所以，**60多MB并不是当前Lite安装程序本身所必需的体积；主要问题是发布包职责混在了一起。** 本轮仅完成分析，没有修改代码或已发布资产。

+## Completion and retirement evidence
+
+Readiness and completion must name the operation, source generation and owning
+scope being observed. A delay, an empty queue, an unchanged counter or the
+absence of a stale effect does not prove that its asynchronous consumer finished.
+Retain and await the actual task before making authoritative no-effect assertions.
+When a browser seam exposes only a transport resolver, pair its integration
+scenario with a component test that captures the real handler or effect task;
+select both through the owning validation contract. Preserve browser interaction,
+current-operation success, native-bridge identity, visual and strict error checks.
+
+Favorites navigation, initial App presentation and ConversationView attachment
+acquisition follow this paired contract. Hold consumer progress independently of
+transport completion, retire its owner, then release and await that exact task.
+Verify that the stale effect remains absent after settlement. A replacement task
+finishing first cannot stand in for the retired task. Qualify changes with a
+temporary guard-bypass control that fails the stale-effect assertion, then restore
+the guard. Fake-time advancement can demonstrate why an old elapsed-time sample
+was insufficient; it must not become the completion witness.
+
+Process execution follows the same rule: a command leader exiting does not prove
+its descendants retired. Shared runners use the validation stage's process owner
+rather than creating an independent nested process group. On POSIX, the outer
+owner retains termination escalation and resource leases through verified group
+retirement, including ignored-stdio descendants and ordinary leader exit.
+Nested cancellation notifies that owner. Windows tree termination must be awaited
+and cleanup failures must remain visible. Cancelled or unverifiably retired work
+cannot admit another suite, fallback build or transport operation, or create a
+successful reusable receipt. Platform evidence must distinguish cancellation from
+an incomplete or mismatched test inventory; success still requires every selected
+step and its positive test counts.
+
+Timers remain appropriate for explicit watchdogs, protocol deadlines, bounded
+state polling, termination grace periods and tests of time-dependent behavior.
+Their expiry signals failure or triggers escalation; elapsed time alone never
+certifies readiness, task completion or cleanup. Preserve documented performance
+assertions separately from harness watchdogs. Fix an incorrect observation or
+work owner before considering a budget change, and use same-source phase evidence
+to justify any deliberate change to a latency contract.
+
+Changes to configured portable browser specs and the portable configuration
*** End Patch"));

body='''## Problem and resulting behavior

Windows workspace validation exposed compound loopback fixtures whose observers shared execution capacity with their peers, and custody preparation that treated best-effort fanout as a remote receipt. Fixtures now retain existing independent runtime owners, stop and join actual work before storage teardown, and prepare custody through authenticated real protocol exchanges with exact durable receipts.

The member invitation test ends after real invitation, epoch delivery, pre-join isolation and role rejection. Its unrelated 204-line owner-transfer/remove/reinvite/offline/reconnect tail is removed. | 同平台、同类型比较 | v0.4.4 Lite | 当前 Nightly |

**下载体积增加了 90.2%，增长几乎全部来自主程序。**

你问“19 MB 分别是什么”：19.10 MiB 是压缩后的大小，不能准确按功能拆账；解压后可以逐段统计：

| 当前主程序内部 | 实际大小 | 相比旧版增加 |

增长来源已经查到几项：

- **加密历史数据库**：新增 SQLCipher，并静态带入 OpenSSL。
- **图片处理**：新增 PNG、GIF、JPEG、WebP 解码依赖。
- **本地 HTTP API**：新增 Axum、Hyper、JSON Schema 相关代码。
- **自动更新**：新增更新器、签名验证、Zstd 差分解压等代码。
- **应用功能本身增加**：业务代码和泛型实例化也扩大了机器代码。

这些依赖都能在实际发布二进制中找到对应符号。不过，**目前不能诚实地给每项功能标出准确的压缩后 MB 数字**，那需要进一步做构建对照。

另外，发现了一个明确的优化空间：**符号裁剪不充分。**我对二进制副本做了裁剪实验：

- 主程序可减少 **7.53 MiB**。

- 这只是副本实验，尚未验证裁剪后的完整应用运行和签名，不能直接当成可发布修复。

因此，**仅清理符号不足以回到原来的约 10 MiB；主要增量仍然是代码和依赖。**新旧发布都已使用 Thin LTO 和单个 codegen unit，也不能把这次增长归咎于“忘开 release 优化”。
